cohort: The cohort consisted of 80 pregnant persons who had cervical cerclage procedures and subsequently experienced cerclage failure before 24 weeks, divided into reinforcing cerclage and expectant management groups.
finding: Reinforcing cerclage following ultrasound evidence of cerclage failure before 24 weeks did not significantly delay gestational age at delivery or reduce rates of preterm and peri-viable birth compared to expectant management, but was associated with an increased rate of placental infection.
